QuestInfo.name: Fox's Threat
QuestInfo.1: When you went to go see the God of Mountains, he was deep in thought. According to him, a fox only becomes an evil Nine-Tailed Fox after a long period of training. Chil Nam seems to have been possessed by this Nine-Tailed Fox, but the God of Mountains cannot defeat the Nine-Tailed Fox with his current powers. So, he needs your help. \n\nThe God of Mountains says the #bgoblins#k in Black Mountain may know something about the Nine-Tailed Fox. Go see the goblins at the #bGoblin House near the Haunted House#k and find out how to defeat the Nine-Tailed Fox. In the meantime, the God of Mountains will find a way to break the Nine-Tailed Fox's spell.
QuestInfo.2: Fortunately, the goblins shared their secret on how to defeat the Old Fox. The God of Mountains was relieved to hear the good news, and urged me to go tell Chil Sung about it. However, even if I told him how to defeat the Old Fox, is Chil Sung up to grab the Old Fox's tail?

0.0: Hmm... hmm... Huh? People don't usually come this far. Have you lost your axe? What? Have I had my clothes ripped off? How did you know? Actually, I was attacked by Samihoes just a few days back.
0.1: A powerful monster has come to Black Mountain not long ago. There's also a fox that's been training for some time. It's become a nine-tailed fox, also known as an #rOld Fox#k. Other Samihoes were influenced by the Old Fox and came to steal my clothes. I'm embarrassed.
0.2: Old foxes are dreadful monsters that can steal away people's souls. We must get rid of it before it's too late. What? Someone already lost their soul? Oh my... I would like to defeat the Old Fox myself, but my powers aren't enough. What should we do...?
0.3: The #bGoblins#k of the Black Mountain may know how to defeat the Old Fox. How about it? Someone like you should go get the information from the Goblins. Of course, those goblins are unusual creatures, and won't just give up their information easily.

yes.0: Hmm, very well then. Please go to the #bDokebi House#k #bnear the Haunted House#k and persuade those Goblins to tell you how to save a someone whose soul was stolen by an Old Fox. Meanwhile, I'll go see my master and ask whether he knows any good spells to use on the Old Fox.

no.0: Indeed... I understand. Goblins don't like humans and are the real owner of the Black Mountain, so even I can't get close to them. I can't blame you if you're scared.

1.0: Hmm... guess you've heard all about the Old Fox by now. Oh, great! The soul will come back by tickling the nose with this #bTail of the Old Fox#k? This is the greatest news I've heard in days. Then hurry and go to, Chil Sung or Chil Nam, whomever, with the good news!

yes.0: My master warned that the Old Fox is more cunning than powerful, so you mustn't listen to what they say. Ask #bChil Sung#k to carry the news around the village to be careful of the Old Fox.

quest.0: Why haven't you gone to the Goblins yet? They are ugly, but they've also lived long enough on Black Mountain to know a lot about it. Hurry and get to the Haunted House first.
